name: Iraq (1959–1963)
description: A vertical tricolor of black, white and green, charged at the centre with a red eight-pointed star bearing a yellow sun disc.
history: The flag of Qasim's republic after the 1958 revolution: uniquely for Iraq it embraced Kurdish and Assyrian symbols alongside Arab ones. Replaced after the 1963 Ba'athist coup.

features.role: star of Ishtar with Kurdish sun
features.symbolism: the yellow sun stands for the Kurds, the red star for the Assyrian heritage — a deliberately non-Arab-nationalist design
